_comment: Baseline snapshot of the C6 PUBLIC developer portal, used by the monthly monitor routine (SIN-68746, Termo C6 clausulas 2.8/2.9/11.5 - F21). The routine diffs a fresh fetch against this file. On a material change it opens a triage issue and updates this baseline + docs/compliance/c6-termo-apis-regras.md. See docs/compliance/c6-termo-apis-monitoring.md for the procedure. This file is DATA, not a secret: it holds only public URLs and content hashes.

static_assets._comment: Content-hashed bundle filenames from index.html. They change on every portal redeploy (Scalar/React build). A change here means 'portal republished' -> review release-notes manually.

release_notes._comment: The changelog page. JS-rendered (Scalar/OpenAPI), so its prose is NOT diffable via curl. Treated as manual-review target when any automatable signal above fires.

termo_de_uso._comment: The signed 'Termo de Uso de APIs' PDF (clausulas 2.8/2.9/11.5) is NOT published on the public portal - it is delivered by C6 to the account holder via the authenticated account/email channel. Its changes are OPERATOR-GATED (non-agent-doable). Owner: CTO (technical impact) + CEO (commercial relationship). The routine emits a monthly manual-review reminder for this.
